correctness.rationale: Both fifth-root rules integrate all polynomials of degree at most five, and their Peano kernels factor exactly as K_plus=z^2(3sqrt5/2-3-z)/720 and K_minus=-z^2(3sqrt5/2+3+z)/720. Since 0<=z<=1/4 and 3sqrt5/2-3>1/4, the kernels are oppositely signed and K_plus-K_minus>0 in the interior. Error/gap is a positive-weight mean of an explicitly linear decreasing function of z; smooth nonnegative-sixth-derivative bumps approach both endpoints. Unique minimax blending follows by balancing extreme ratios. Symbolic checker verified all critical identities and additional exact examples.

value.rationale: This supplies a sharp computable certificate from only endpoint derivatives for a natural higher-order convexity class, and an optimal fixed corrected quadrature. The refined interval is 1/(12sqrt5) of the original pair’s gap; its minimax midpoint has 1/(24sqrt5) of the gap as a sharp error bound. This allows a derivative-only composite tolerance test without derivative-magnitude bounds. The restriction to exact jet data and sixth-derivative sign is explicit; no broader optimality or numerical robustness is asserted.
